termEs: Representar desigualdades en una recta numérica
def: Show all the answers on a line with a dot and arrow.
defEs: Mostrar todas las respuestas en una recta con un punto y una flecha.
alt: Illustration of Graph Inequalities: Show all the answers on a line with a dot and arrow.

def: A line with numbers in order, left to right.
defEs: Una recta con los números en orden, de izquierda a derecha.
alt: Illustration of Number line: A line with numbers in order, left to right.

def: An empty circle. The number is left out.
defEs: Un círculo vacío. El número NO está incluido.
alt: Illustration of Open circle: An empty circle. The number is left out.

def: A filled circle. The number is part of the answer.
defEs: Un círculo relleno. El número es parte de la respuesta.
alt: Illustration of Closed circle: A filled circle. The number is part of the answer.

def: All the values that make the sentence true.
defEs: Todos los valores que hacen verdadera la oración.
alt: Illustration of Solution set: All the values that make the sentence true.

def: A math sentence that compares sides with <, >, ≤, or ≥.
defEs: Una oración matemática que compara lados con <, >, ≤ o ≥.
alt: Illustration of Inequality: A math sentence that compares sides with <, >, ≤, or ≥.

def: The number at the edge of the solutions on a number line.
defEs: El número en el borde de las soluciones en la recta numérica.
alt: Illustration of Boundary point: The number at the edge of the solutions on a number line.

def: A math sentence that is correct.
defEs: Una oración matemática que es correcta.
alt: Illustration of True statement: A math sentence that is correct.
